about_the_game:
The Odyssey of Commander Cookie unfolds across three unlockable chapters, each with its own distinct gameplay mode. Complete one, and you'll unlock the next, building toward a full-scale cat fight on the mice empire.

🐭 Guardian Killer

Face relentless waves of increasingly powerful mice ships as you battle your way toward one of the three Planetary Guardians. Create unique builds using a variety of ships, weapons, cat pilots, and special ability cards. Survive long enough, and you'll earn the chance to challenge one of the guardians.
Do you have what it takes to face the guardians?

💣 Payload (Planned for a future update)

Escort the P.U.R.R. (Payload: Universal Rat Remover) through the fortified districts of the city of Verminax. Fend off escalating waves of resistance as you push the weapon to the very heart of the mouse technocracy.
One way in. No way back!

🚀 Extraction (Planned for a future update)

With the P.U.R.R. deployed, it's a race against time to navigate your ship through the explosive chaos of the planetary annihilation and reach the extraction point before the blast consumes everything.
Survival isn't guaranteed, just highly recommended.

Gameplay:

Choose your loadout from a roster of unlockable cats, ships, and weapons. Mix and match to suit your playstyle.

During each run, collect resources by defeating enemies and destroying the environment. Once enough resources have been gathered, the mothership will reward you with upgrade beacons. Activating them, lets you choose from three upgrade paths: Armory, Defense, or Tech. These upgrades function like ability cards, with dozens of unique effects from status boosts to powerful new abilities, letting you craft a one-of-a-kind build every time you play.

As difficulty ramps up, optional mini-challenges appear. Complete them to earn ship modules, powerful active perks that trigger once you hit a certain kill multiplier.

Craft the perfect build, adapt on the fly, and survive the escalating onslaught in classic roguelite fashion, feline style.

Key Features

Dynamic Builds: With dozens of different upgrades to choose from, no two attempts will ever be the same.

Ship-Modules system: Improve your skills and earn active, powerful abilities by completing mini-challenges. Unlock ship modules that provide unique, game-changing perks.

Diverse Cast & Arsenal: Mix and match across a wide variety of unlockable characters, ships, and weapons to find the perfect combination for your playstyle.

Pick Up And Play: Designed for quick 15-20 minute runs, perfect for fast, action-packed sessions that fit right into your day.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.4 GHz
  • Graphics: 2GB VRAM / DirectX 11+ support
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Dual Core 3.0 GHz+
  • Graphics: 4GB VRAM / DirectX 11+ support
  • Storage: 700 MB available space

short_description: Take command of the PSS, Paw Space Squadron, and catfight your way through relentless swarms of cybermice. Scavenge their tech. Upgrade your ship and weapons and unlock a fleet of fellow cat heroes, as you claw your way to victory in this intense roguelite twin-stick shooter.
